descent_landscape_lab.name: Where Does Downhill Take You?
descent_landscape_lab.description: A six-metre objective landscape with step/run, two surfaces, three starts, four step sizes and three stopping tolerances. Reveal finite-difference slope and the update after observing paths. Domain exit, small slope and step limit are distinct outcomes.
interactions: Change RATE and STOP tolerance; each starts a new comparison
PARTS and RULE reveal coordinates, slope and code
descent_landscape_lab.qfep_connection: An authored objective and stopping threshold select which configurations count as acceptable; numerical optimisation is not a claim about all living form.
